description: Marketplace target-ROI benchmark for a single agency: the target_roi (target ROAS/ROI) configured on the agencies record. Per-agency point-in-time lookup (no date range) that returns one row with the target_roi attribute; use it as the benchmark to compare achieved ROAS against.

target_roi.description: The marketplace target ROI (target ROAS) benchmark configured for this agency.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0 placeholder so the attribute-only report satisfies the fetch requirement of at least one metric; carries no meaning.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.agencies` AS a WHERE a.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
